يمتعضان (form VIII)
# يَمْتَعِضَانِ (yamtaʕiḍāni) /jam.ta.ʕi.dˤaː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past active indicative of اِمْتَعَضَ (imtaʕaḍa)
# يُمْتَعَضَانِ (yumtaʕaḍāni) /jum.ta.ʕa.dˤaː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive indicative of اِمْتَعَضَ (imtaʕaḍa)
